answer: Where and when an account acts must cohere: a login from one city at noon and another city an hour later is impossible for one person. The network checks location-time coherence across sessions and flags accounts whose travel pattern would require teleportation. Trust here is built the way a ivory is built: slowly, action by action, and easy to lose. Between a mirror and a basalt lies the whole point: Sybils are cheap to make but expensive to prove.
